# Functions {-}


```{r echo=FALSE}
## Define  interaction table functions {-}

compact_emm_table <- function(emm_object,
                              by_var,
                              condition_prefix = NULL,
                              reverse = FALSE,      # TRUE = later level minus earlier (revpairwise)
                              adjust = NULL,        # NULL = emmeans default; e.g. "none", "tukey", "holm"
                              digits_est = 2,
                              digits_df = 1,
                              digits_p = 3,
                              digits_by = 2) {      # decimals shown for numeric by-values (e.g. OS, LP)

  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |> as.data.frame()

  # by_var can be one bare name (by_var = OS) or several (by_var = c(family_size, OS))
  by_names <- names(tidyselect::eval_select(rlang::enquo(by_var), emm_df))

  contrast_df <- if (is.null(adjust)) {
    pairs(emm_object, reverse = reverse)
  } else {
    pairs(emm_object, reverse = reverse, adjust = adjust)
  }
  contrast_df <- contrast_df |> summary() |> as.data.frame()

  # Exclude BOTH Satterthwaite/KR-style and asymptotic-style CI/df column names
  non_focal_cols <- c(by_names, "emmean", "SE", "df",
                      "lower.CL", "upper.CL",
                      "asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL")
  focal_vars <- setdiff(names(emm_df), non_focal_cols)

  # Detect whichever CI column names are actually present
  lcl_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(emm_df))
  ucl_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(emm_df))

  # Condition label: a bare value (single by-variable, no prefix, as before),
  # "prefix = value" (single by-variable with prefix), or
  # "name = value, name = value" (several by-variables)
  fmt_by <- function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits_by) else as.character(x)
  }
  make_condition <- function(df) {
    if (length(by_names) == 1) {
      v <- fmt_by(df[[by_names]])
      if (is.null(condition_prefix)) v else paste(condition_prefix, "=", v)
    } else {
      parts <- lapply(by_names, function(n) paste(n, "=", fmt_by(df[[n]])))
      do.call(paste, c(parts, sep = ", "))
    }
  }

  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(Comparison = paste(c_across(all_of(focal_vars)), collapse = " ")) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(Condition = make_condition(pick(everything()))) |>
    transmute(
      across(all_of(by_names)),          # kept temporarily for sorting
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = if (length(lcl_col) > 0) .data[[lcl_col]] else NA_real_,
      upper.CL = if (length(ucl_col) > 0) .data[[ucl_col]] else NA_real_,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )

  # Detect whichever test-statistic column name is present (t.ratio vs z.ratio)
  ratio_col <- intersect(c("t.ratio", "z.ratio"), names(contrast_df))

  contrast_part <- contrast_df |>
    mutate(Comparison = as.character(contrast),
           Condition  = make_condition(pick(everything()))) |>
    transmute(
      across(all_of(by_names)),
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio = if (length(ratio_col) > 0) .data[[ratio_col]] else NA_real_,
      p.value
    )

  # Sort by the by-variables' actual values (numeric order for OS/LP, level
  # order for factors), not by the text label, then drop them
  bind_rows(emm_part, contrast_part) |>
    arrange(across(all_of(by_names)), Comparison) |>
    select(-all_of(by_names)) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    )
}


```


# Load Files

```{r load_files, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load data: erp_fs nonwords
erp_fs_nw <- read_csv("erp_fs_dmg.csv") |>
  filter(lexical_status == "nonword") |>
  mutate(
    SubjID = factor(SubjID),
    chlabel = factor(chlabel),
    family_size = factor(family_size, 
                         levels = c("small", "large")),
    complexity = factor(complexity,
                    levels = c("simple", "complex")),
    time_window = factor(time_window),
    OS = as.numeric(Dim.2),
    LP = as.numeric(Dim.1)
  )

range(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE)
```



# N250 NONWORD DATA : SYMMETRICAL MODEL, INTERACTION WITH LP AND OS

For the nonword N250, does the symmetric model we just ran replace the separate LP and OS models, or do all three get reported?**

The symmetric model is the cleanest solution — it tests both dimensions in the same model and provides the strongest evidence for the dissociation. The separate models are now superseded.

## N250 NONWORD DATA: Family Size

### Model Comparisons
```{r}
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$complexity)   <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$family_size)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# Full four-way
m_full_nw_n250_fs <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N250"),
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

print(summary(m_full_nw_n250_fs), correlation = TRUE)

# Effect Sizes
eta_squared(m_full_nw_n250_fs, partial = TRUE)

# R-squared
r2_nakagawa(m_full_nw_n250_fs)
```




```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)

emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

# Representative levels: mean ± 1 SD for both continuous ID dimensions
subj <- erp_fs_nw |>
  distinct(SubjID, OS, LP) |>
  filter(!is.na(OS), !is.na(LP))

nrow(subj)   # should be 63

os_vals <- mean(subj$OS) + c(-1, 0, 1) * sd(subj$OS)
lp_vals <- mean(subj$LP) + c(-1, 0, 1) * sd(subj$LP)
os_labels <- c("Low OS", "Mean OS", "High OS")
lp_labels <- c("Low LP", "Mean LP", "High LP")

os_vals
lp_vals
```


## Complexity x Family Size x LP x OS

```{r  n250_fourway}
# 1. Complexity effect (complex - simple) within each family size,
#    across the full LP x OS grid (cell means plus simple effects)
n250_4way_1 <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity | family_size * LP * OS,
                       at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
  compact_emm_table(by_var = c(family_size, LP, OS), reverse = TRUE)
as_tibble(n250_4way_1) |> print(n = 60)

# 2. Complexity x Family Size interaction contrast across the LP x OS grid
#    (this is the 3 x 3 table: does the complexity effect differ by family size,
#     for each combination of LP and OS?)
n250_4way_2 <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP * OS,
                       at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  as.data.frame()
as_tibble(n250_4way_2) |> print(n = 50)

# 3a. The Complexity x Family Size x OS three-way (slope of OS) at each LP level
#     -- how the OS three-way changes with LP is the four-way
emtrends(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP, var = "OS",
         at = list(LP = lp_vals)) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise")

# 3b. The Complexity x Family Size x LP three-way (slope of LP) at each OS level
emtrends(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | OS, var = "LP",
         at = list(OS = os_vals)) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise")
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# N250 nonwords: Complexity x Family Size x LP x OS
# Requires: m_full_nw_n250_fs (REML fit), erp_fs_nw, lp_vals, os_vals
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

fix_ci <- function(df) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
  df
}

lp_lab <- c("Low LP (-1 SD)", "Mean LP", "High LP (+1 SD)")
os_lab <- c("Low OS (-1 SD)", "Mean OS", "High OS (+1 SD)")
cols   <- c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")

# ---- Plot 1: cell means in a 3 x 3 grid (rows = LP, columns = OS) ----------
cells <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP * OS,
                 at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
  as.data.frame() |> fix_ci() |>
  mutate(LP_level = factor(LP, levels = lp_vals, labels = lp_lab),
         OS_level = factor(OS, levels = os_vals, labels = os_lab),
         family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large"),
                              labels = c("Small", "Large")),
         complexity  = factor(complexity, levels = c("simple", "complex"),
                              labels = c("Simple", "Complex")))

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.25)
p1 <- ggplot(cells, aes(family_size, emmean, colour = complexity, linetype = complexity, group = complexity)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(position = pd, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.12,
                position = pd, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(LP_level ~ OS_level) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Simple = "dashed", Complex = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Family size", y = expression("Predicted N250 amplitude (" * mu * "V)"),
       colour = "Complexity", linetype = "Complexity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
p1

# ---- Plot 2: complexity effect (Complex - Simple) by family size, same grid --
#      A flat line = no Complexity x Family Size interaction in that panel;
#      a steep line = a strong interaction.
cx <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity | family_size * LP * OS,
              at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  as.data.frame() |> fix_ci() |>
  mutate(LP_level = factor(LP, levels = lp_vals, labels = lp_lab),
         OS_level = factor(OS, levels = os_vals, labels = os_lab),
         family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large"),
                              labels = c("Small", "Large")))

p2 <- ggplot(cx, aes(family_size, estimate, group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.1, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, colour = "grey15") +
  facet_grid(LP_level ~ OS_level) +
  labs(x = "Family size",
       y = expression("Complexity effect, Complex-Simple (" * mu * "V)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p2

# ---- Plot 3: the interaction contrast as a continuous surface ---------------
#      Colour = Complexity x Family Size interaction contrast
#      ((Complex-Simple for large) - (Complex-Simple for small)).
#      Black contour = |t| = 1.96; points = participants.
subj <- erp_fs_nw |> distinct(SubjID, OS, LP) |> filter(!is.na(OS), !is.na(LP))
grid_lp <- seq(min(subj$LP), max(subj$LP), length.out = 40)
grid_os <- seq(min(subj$OS), max(subj$OS), length.out = 40)

surf <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP * OS,
                at = list(LP = grid_lp, OS = grid_os), nesting = NULL) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |>
  as.data.frame()
surf$t <- surf$estimate / surf$SE

lim <- max(abs(surf$estimate))
p3 <- ggplot(surf, aes(OS, LP)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = estimate), interpolate = TRUE) +
  geom_contour(aes(z = t), breaks = c(-1.96, 1.96), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = subj, aes(OS, LP), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = os_vals, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lp_vals, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       name = "Interaction\ncontrast (uV)") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Orthographic Sensitivity (PCA score)",
       y = "Language Proficiency (PCA score)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
p3

ggsave("N250_4way_cells.png",    p1, width = 7.5, height = 7,   dpi = 300)
ggsave("N250_4way_cxeffect.png", p2, width = 7,   height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("N250_4way_surface.png",  p3, width = 6.5, height = 5,   dpi = 300)

```

## Complexity x Family Size X LP


```{r}
# Complexity effect (complex - simple) within each family size, at each LP level
n250_fs_3way_LP_2 <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity | family_size * LP,
                             at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals[2]), nesting = NULL) |>
  compact_emm_table(by_var = c(family_size, LP), reverse = TRUE)
as.tibble(n250_fs_3way_LP_2) |> print(n = 50)

# Gives ((complex − simple) for large) minus ((complex − simple) for small)
n250_fs_3way_LP_2b <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP,
                              at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals[2]), nesting = NULL) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |>
  as.data.frame() 
as.tibble(n250_fs_3way_LP_2b) |> print(n = 50)

# Gives the LP slope for complex nonwords minus the LP slope for simple nonwords, within each family size. 
# That difference is the Complexity × LP interaction at that family size. 
emtrends(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity | family_size, var = "LP") |> contrast("revpairwise")

# Gives the large-family complexity slop difference minus the small-family complexity slope difference
emtrends(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size, var = "LP",
         at = list(OS = os_vals[2])) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise")
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# N250 nonwords: Complexity x Family Size x LP
# Requires: m_full_nw_n250_fs (REML fit) and erp_fs_nw from your Rmd
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

# Participant-level LP scores (one row per participant, not per observation)
subj   <- erp_fs_nw |> distinct(SubjID, LP) |> filter(!is.na(LP))
lp_m   <- mean(subj$LP)
lp_sd  <- sd(subj$LP)
lp_pts <- c(lp_m - lp_sd, lp_m, lp_m + lp_sd)

# Some emmeans settings name the CI columns asymp.LCL / asymp.UCL; standardise them
fix_ci <- function(df) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
  df
}

# ---- Plot A: cell means at LP = -1 SD, mean, +1 SD ------------------------
emm_A <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | LP,
                 at = list(LP = lp_pts)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  fix_ci() |>
  mutate(OS_level = factor(LP, levels = lp_pts,
                           labels = c("LP -1 SD", "LP mean", "LP +1 SD")),
         family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large"),
                              labels = c("Small", "Large")),
         complexity  = factor(complexity, levels = c("simple", "complex"),
                              labels = c("Simple", "Complex")))

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.25)

p_A <- ggplot(emm_A, aes(x = family_size, y = emmean,
                         colour = complexity, linetype = complexity, group = complexity)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(position = pd, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.12, position = pd, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ OS_level) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Simple = "dashed", Complex = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Family size", y = expression("Predicted N250 amplitude (" * mu * "V)"),
       colour = "Complexity", linetype = "Complexity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
# Add scale_y_reverse() if you want negative plotted up.

p_A

# ---- Plot B: family size effect (Large - Small) across the observed LP range --
lp_grid <- seq(min(subj$LP), max(subj$LP), length.out = 40)

emm_B <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ family_size | complexity * LP,
                 at = list(LP = lp_grid)) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>          # large - small
  confint() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  fix_ci() |>
  mutate(complexity = factor(complexity, levels = c("simple", "complex"),
                             labels = c("Simple", "Complex")))

p_B <- ggplot(emm_B, aes(x = LP, y = estimate,
                         colour = complexity, linetype = complexity, fill = complexity)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lp_pts, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_rug(data = subj, aes(x = LP), inherit.aes = FALSE,
           sides = "b", alpha = 0.5, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Simple = "dashed", Complex = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Orthographic Sensitivity (PCA score)",
       y = expression("Family size effect, Large-Small (" * mu * "V)"),
       colour = "Complexity", fill = "Complexity", linetype = "Complexity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

p_B

# ---- Save -------------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("Figure_N250_CxFSxLP_cells.png", p_A, width = 7.5, height = 3.6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figure_N250_CxFSxLP_FSeffect.png", p_B, width = 5.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# N250 nonwords: Complexity x Family Size x OS
# Requires: m_full_nw_n250_fs (REML fit) and erp_fs_nw from your Rmd
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

# Participant-level OS scores (one row per participant, not per observation)
subj   <- erp_fs_nw |> distinct(SubjID, OS) |> filter(!is.na(OS))
os_m   <- mean(subj$OS)
os_sd  <- sd(subj$OS)
os_pts <- c(os_m - os_sd, os_m, os_m + os_sd)

# Some emmeans settings name the CI columns asymp.LCL / asymp.UCL; standardise them
fix_ci <- function(df) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
  df
}

# ---- Plot A: cell means at OS = -1 SD, mean, +1 SD ------------------------
emm_A <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity * family_size | OS,
                 at = list(OS = os_pts)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  fix_ci() |>
  mutate(OS_level = factor(OS, levels = os_pts,
                           labels = c("OS -1 SD", "OS mean", "OS +1 SD")),
         family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large"),
                              labels = c("Small", "Large")),
         complexity  = factor(complexity, levels = c("simple", "complex"),
                              labels = c("Simple", "Complex")))

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.25)

p_A <- ggplot(emm_A, aes(x = family_size, y = emmean,
                         colour = complexity, linetype = complexity, group = complexity)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(position = pd, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.12, position = pd, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ OS_level) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Simple = "dashed", Complex = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Family size", y = expression("Predicted N250 amplitude (" * mu * "V)"),
       colour = "Complexity", linetype = "Complexity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
# Add scale_y_reverse() if you want negative plotted up.

p_A

# ---- Plot B: family size effect (Large - Small) across the observed OS range --
os_grid <- seq(min(subj$OS), max(subj$OS), length.out = 40)

emm_B <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ family_size | complexity * OS,
                 at = list(OS = os_grid)) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>          # large - small
  confint() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  fix_ci() |>
  mutate(complexity = factor(complexity, levels = c("simple", "complex"),
                             labels = c("Simple", "Complex")))

p_B <- ggplot(emm_B, aes(x = OS, y = estimate,
                         colour = complexity, linetype = complexity, fill = complexity)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = os_pts, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_rug(data = subj, aes(x = OS), inherit.aes = FALSE,
           sides = "b", alpha = 0.5, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = c(Simple = "#1b6ca8", Complex = "#d1495b")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Simple = "dashed", Complex = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Orthographic Sensitivity (PCA score)",
       y = expression("Family size effect, Large-Small (" * mu * "V)"),
       colour = "Complexity", fill = "Complexity", linetype = "Complexity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

p_B

# ---- Save -------------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("Figure_N250_CxFSxOS_cells.png", p_A, width = 7.5, height = 3.6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figure_N250_CxFSxOS_FSeffect.png", p_B, width = 5.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Each row is the OS slope of the complexity effect at one LP level, averaged over family size. 
# Because the four-way is significant, that average is a summary, not the full picture.
emtrends(m_full_nw_n250_fs, ~ complexity | LP, var = "OS",
         at = list(LP = lp_vals)) |>
  contrast("revpairwise")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# N250 nonwords: Complexity x LP x OS
# Complexity effect (Complex - Simple) across the observed OS range,
# one line per LP level (-1 SD, mean, +1 SD).
# Requires: m_full_nw_n250_fs (REML fit), erp_fs_nw, lp_vals
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

fix_ci <- function(df) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
  names(df)[names(df) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
  df
}

subj    <- erp_fs_nw |> distinct(SubjID, OS, LP) |> filter(!is.na(OS), !is.na(LP))
os_grid <- seq(min(subj$OS), max(subj$OS), length.out = 40)
os_pts  <- mean(subj$OS) + c(-1, 0, 1) * sd(subj$OS)
lp_lab  <- c("Low LP (-1 SD)", "Mean LP", "High LP (+1 SD)")
lp_cols <- c("#e08214", "grey35", "#5e3c99")
lp_lnty <- c("solid", "dashed","dotdash" )
names(lp_cols) <- lp_lab

# Complexity effect at each OS value x LP level
cx_os_lp <- function(by_family_size = FALSE) {
  spec <- if (by_family_size) ~ complexity | OS * LP * family_size else ~ complexity | OS * LP
  emmeans(m_full_nw_n250_fs, spec,
          at = list(OS = os_grid, LP = lp_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
    contrast("revpairwise") |>                  # complex - simple
    summary(infer = TRUE) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    fix_ci() |>
    mutate(LP_level = factor(LP, levels = lp_vals, labels = lp_lab))
}

base_plot <- function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(OS, estimate, colour = LP_level, fill = LP_level, linetype = LP_level)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = os_pts, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_rug(data = subj, aes(x = OS), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             sides = "b", alpha = 0.5, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = lp_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lp_cols) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = lp_lnty) +
    labs(x = "Orthographic Sensitivity (PCA score)",
         y = expression("Complexity effect, Complex-Simple (" * mu * "V)"),
         colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
}

# ---- Plot 1: averaged over family size (what the three-way term describes) --
p1 <- base_plot(cx_os_lp(FALSE))
p1

# ---- Plot 2: the same, split by family size (shows what the average hides) --
p2 <- base_plot(cx_os_lp(TRUE) |>
                  mutate(family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large"),
                                              labels = c("Small family", "Large family")))) +
  facet_wrap(~ family_size)
p2

ggsave("N250_CxLPxOS_avg.png",   p1, width = 5.5, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("N250_CxLPxOS_byFS.png",  p2, width = 8.5, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)
```
